weeks.title: Python Fundamentals
weeks.objective: Write small, correct Python programs using core language features and an isolated development environment.
topics: Install Python 3, select a supported interpreter, and create a virtual environment
Use variables, numeric/string/boolean/None values, and inspect types
Choose lists, tuples, sets, and dictionaries for appropriate access patterns
Use conditions, loops, comprehensions, string methods, and functions
Handle expected exceptions and write focused unit tests

tasks.text: Create a Python 3 virtual environment and pyproject.toml; record interpreter and run commands in README.
Implement tested exercises for collections, comprehensions, strings, exceptions, and functions.
Build a JSON-summary CLI with argparse, file validation, useful exit codes, and pytest coverage.
Add edge-case tests for malformed JSON, missing fields, and empty input.

weeks.deliverable: A tested command-line utility that parses and summarizes a JSON file.

weeks.title: Professional Python
weeks.objective: Organize typed Python code into packages with explicit models, logging, and repeatable dependency setup.
topics: Model business concepts with classes, composition, inheritance, and dataclasses
Add type hints to function boundaries and run a static type checker
Create modules and packages; manage dependencies with pip and pyproject.toml
Read and write files and JSON safely using pathlib and context managers
Add structured logging, useful exceptions, and a clear project layout

tasks.text: Refactor the CLI into a package with typed dataclasses and small cohesive modules.
Add structured logging and safe configuration via environment variables.
Add file processing with pathlib and context managers; test resource cleanup.
Run formatting, lint, type checks, and pytest from a documented clean setup.

weeks.deliverable: A packaged Python CLI with typed modules, structured logs, configuration, and tests.

weeks.title: Advanced Python Foundations
weeks.objective: Use Python protocols and concurrency tools deliberately and verify behavior with pytest and HTTPX.
topics: Implement iterators, generators, decorators, and context managers
Use asyncio, async/await, tasks, cancellation, and semaphores
Explain I/O concurrency tradeoffs, CPU-bound work, threads, processes, and the GIL
Call an HTTP API with HTTPX using timeouts and error handling
Write pytest fixtures, parametrized tests, and debugging workflows

tasks.text: Implement a generator-based file reader and a decorator/context manager with tests.
Write an asyncio HTTPX client with deadlines, cancellation, and bounded concurrency.
Compare asyncio, threads, and processes using a small I/O and CPU exercise.
Build pytest fixtures and parametrized tests for client failures and retries.

weeks.deliverable: A tested asynchronous API client package with clear typing, logging, and project structure.

weeks.title: FastAPI Fundamentals
weeks.objective: Build a documented API with validated contracts, clear routing, dependencies, and predictable errors.
topics: Structure a FastAPI app using routers and application factories
Implement HTTP methods, path/query parameters, status codes, and response models
Validate nested request data with Pydantic and produce useful errors
Use dependency injection for settings and service boundaries
Inspect generated OpenAPI and Swagger UI; test endpoints with HTTPX

tasks.text: Create a FastAPI application factory with versioned routers and settings.
Implement CRUD-style endpoints using Pydantic request/response schemas.
Add dependency-injected service boundaries and centralized domain error mapping.
Test success, validation, not-found, OpenAPI, and error response behavior with HTTPX.

weeks.deliverable: A versioned FastAPI task API with typed schemas, OpenAPI docs, and endpoint tests.

weeks.title: PostgreSQL and SQLAlchemy
weeks.objective: Persist domain data reliably using relational design, SQLAlchemy 2.0, and Alembic.
topics: Design PostgreSQL tables, keys, constraints, indexes, and normalized relationships
Write joins, aggregates, filtering, sorting, and pagination SQL
Use SQLAlchemy 2.0 declarative mappings, sessions, relationships, and query APIs
Handle transactions, rollback, isolation, and connection pool configuration
Generate, inspect, apply, and safely revise Alembic migrations

tasks.text: Design PostgreSQL tables, constraints, indexes, relationships, and representative SQL queries.
Map domain records with SQLAlchemy 2.0 and test repository behavior.
Create Alembic migrations and verify upgrade from an empty database.
Exercise transaction rollback, pagination queries, and connection-pool configuration.

weeks.deliverable: A FastAPI resource API with PostgreSQL persistence, migrations, transactions, and tests.

weeks.title: Production API Security
weeks.objective: Implement authentication and authorization with safe credentials, query behavior, and API tests.
topics: Hash passwords with a suitable password hashing library and verify credentials safely
Implement JWT access tokens and refresh-token rotation/revocation flows
Enforce role and resource authorization at service boundaries
Add pagination, filtering, sorting, upload limits, and input validation
Test auth success/failure paths and security behavior with HTTPX and pytest

tasks.text: Implement secure password hashing and registration/login endpoints.
Add short-lived access tokens and refresh-token rotation with revocation tests.
Enforce role and object-level permissions for owned records.
Add pagination/filtering/upload limits and HTTPX tests for denied and malformed requests.

weeks.deliverable: An authenticated FastAPI API with documented access rules and security-focused tests.

weeks.title: Async Services and Background Work
weeks.objective: Operate async APIs and background jobs using Redis, streaming, and observability basics.
topics: Use async PostgreSQL access where it improves concurrency; avoid blocking the event loop
Choose FastAPI background tasks versus a durable Celery worker for the workload
Use Redis for caching, rate limits, and task coordination with expiration rules
Implement and test WebSocket and Server-Sent Events endpoints
Add centralized exception handling, structured logs, retries, and idempotency

tasks.text: Add Redis caching with expiration, tenant-safe cache keys, and invalidation behavior.
Move a durable long-running operation to Celery; test retries and idempotency.
Add rate limiting and bounded async database/provider calls.
Stream progress using SSE and test disconnect cleanup, centralized errors, and structured logs.

weeks.deliverable: A Dockerized async FastAPI service with Redis-backed jobs, SSE, and tests.

weeks.title: LLM Fundamentals
weeks.objective: Explain model behavior and connect a Python service to local and hosted compatible inference APIs.
topics: Differentiate AI, machine learning, deep learning, and language models
Understand transformer blocks, tokenization, context limits, and sampling
Measure inference latency and understand quantization tradeoffs
Compare local Ollama models with hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoints
Build a Python provider client with configuration, timeouts, and error handling

tasks.text: Compare two local Ollama models and one compatible hosted endpoint on a fixed prompt set.
Measure token counts, latency, output consistency, and quantization tradeoffs.
Build a typed provider adapter with configuration, timeout, and error classification.
Write a short model selection report that separates measured results from assumptions.

weeks.deliverable: A documented model comparison and typed Python inference adapter.

weeks.title: LLM Application Development
weeks.objective: Build dependable LLM features using prompts, validated structured output, tools, and streaming.
topics: Design system/user messages and versioned prompt templates
Request structured JSON output and validate it with Pydantic
Implement function/tool calling with allowlisted server-side dispatch
Stream responses over SSE and handle cancellation and disconnects
Add retries, timeouts, usage accounting, token budgets, and cost controls

tasks.text: Create versioned prompt templates and a Pydantic extraction schema.
Validate structured model output and handle malformed responses with bounded retries.
Implement a read-only function/tool dispatcher with typed arguments and authorization.
Stream responses over SSE and track request IDs, latency, token use, and spend estimates.

weeks.deliverable: A FastAPI LLM feature with structured extraction, a read-only tool, streaming, and tests.

weeks.title: Embeddings and Vector Search
weeks.objective: Create an embedding retrieval service with traceable chunks and PostgreSQL pgvector.
topics: Compare embedding model behavior and vector dimensions
Measure cosine/dot-product similarity and inspect failure cases
Design chunking with overlap, stable IDs, and source metadata
Store vectors with pgvector and choose indexes based on query patterns
Apply tenant and metadata filters safely to semantic retrieval

tasks.text: Embed a small labeled corpus and inspect nearest-neighbor results for representative queries.
Compare chunk sizes/overlap and record source offsets and stable IDs.
Store vectors in PostgreSQL pgvector and implement filtered top-k search.
Benchmark exact and approximate search while checking recall and tenant boundaries.

weeks.deliverable: A reproducible embedding and pgvector search experiment with labeled queries.

weeks.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
weeks.objective: Build a document ingestion and answer flow that retrieves useful evidence and cites sources.
topics: Extract text from PDFs and preserve page/source provenance
Build idempotent ingestion, chunking, embedding, and re-indexing steps
Combine lexical PostgreSQL full-text search with vector search
Rerank candidate evidence and build a bounded context window
Generate cited answers with explicit abstention when evidence is weak

tasks.text: Implement idempotent PDF ingestion with extraction errors and page-level provenance.
Generate chunks and embeddings asynchronously; support re-indexing by source version.
Add PostgreSQL full-text search and fuse lexical/vector candidate rankings.
Rerank evidence, generate cited answers, and abstain when evidence is insufficient.

weeks.deliverable: AI Document Intelligence: Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL/pgvector, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and citations.

weeks.title: RAG Evaluation
weeks.objective: Measure retrieval and answer quality with a repeatable test set and regression analysis.
topics: Create versioned evaluation questions with expected source evidence
Measure retrieval recall/precision and inspect rank failures
Score answer relevance, faithfulness, citations, and unsupported claims
Use automated judges cautiously alongside deterministic checks and human review
Run experiments for chunking, filters, hybrid weights, and reranking

tasks.text: Create versioned question/source labels and retrieval relevance judgments.
Measure recall@k, answer relevance, faithfulness, citation accuracy, and abstention behavior.
Compare chunking, hybrid weights, and reranking with reproducible runs.
Add a regression suite with human review notes and documented metric limitations.

weeks.deliverable: A RAG evaluation report with reproducible dataset, metrics, and regression tests.

weeks.title: AI Agent Fundamentals
weeks.objective: Build bounded, observable tool workflows with explicit state and safe stopping rules.
topics: Separate deterministic workflow orchestration from model reasoning
Design typed tool contracts and execution loops with limits
Track state and conversation context with clear retention rules
Handle timeouts, malformed tool arguments, and partial failures
Evaluate tool selection and task completion using scenario fixtures

tasks.text: Implement typed allowlisted tools and a bounded execution loop.
Keep model-proposed arguments separate from authenticated user and tenant context.
Persist workflow state and conversation memory with explicit retention rules.
Test timeouts, malformed tool calls, failure recovery, and stop conditions.

weeks.deliverable: A bounded Python business workflow using authorized read-only tools.

weeks.title: LangGraph Orchestration
weeks.objective: Model multi-step agent workflows as explicit graphs with persistence and human approval.
topics: Define LangGraph state, nodes, edges, and conditional routing
Persist checkpoints and resume interrupted workflows safely
Use streaming and interrupts for human-in-the-loop decisions
Test branching, retries, and workflow state transitions
Keep prompts and tool execution behind typed service boundaries

tasks.text: Build a LangGraph state model with typed state and deterministic nodes.
Add conditional routing, checkpoint persistence, and safe resume behavior.
Implement a human approval interrupt and approved/denied branches.
Test graph transitions, retries, checkpoint restore, and streamed progress.

weeks.deliverable: A persisted LangGraph workflow with approval, resume, and graph tests.

weeks.title: Secure Enterprise Integrations
weeks.objective: Integrate AI tools with business APIs using tenant-aware permissions and auditability.
topics: Wrap ERP/CRM APIs as narrow Python service tools with HTTPX timeouts
Propagate authenticated user and tenant context from API to tools
Enforce role and object-level permissions independently of model output
Create approval records for consequential actions and preserve audit trails
Test tenant isolation, denied actions, and data minimization

tasks.text: Wrap mock ERP/CRM endpoints with HTTPX timeouts, typed errors, and service contracts.
Implement customer and invoice read tools with tenant and role enforcement.
Add an approval record for consequential actions and an immutable audit trail.
Test cross-tenant access denial, approval paths, audit coverage, and data minimization.

weeks.deliverable: AI Business Assistant with authorized customer/invoice lookup and approval workflow.

weeks.title: Reliable AI Agents
weeks.objective: Harden tool workflows against retries, tool failures, prompt injection, and runaway execution.
topics: Add bounded retries, deadlines, idempotency keys, and recovery paths
Apply step, token, and tool budgets with explicit stop conditions
Treat documents and tool results as untrusted against prompt injection
Trace graph transitions, tool requests, errors, and decisions
Build adversarial and failure-injection evaluation scenarios

tasks.text: Add provider/tool retry policies with deadlines, idempotency keys, and bounded attempts.
Create failure-injection tests for provider outage, tool errors, and duplicate deliveries.
Test prompt injection in retrieved documents and constrain tool/model authority.
Instrument graph transitions and evaluate normal, adversarial, and recovery scenarios.

weeks.deliverable: A resilient, security-tested AI assistant workflow with operational traces.

weeks.title: AI Application Security
weeks.objective: Threat-model an AI backend and enforce controls across inputs, outputs, data, and tools.
topics: Test direct/indirect prompt injection and malicious retrieved content
Validate inputs and outputs; escape rendered/user-controlled values
Prevent tenant leakage in SQL, cache keys, vector filters, and logs
Protect secrets, tokens, uploads, and sensitive personal/business data
Apply least privilege, audit controls, retention, and abuse limits

tasks.text: Write a threat model covering inputs, uploads, retrieval, prompts, tools, tenants, and logs.
Add input/output validation, upload size/content checks, and secrets management.
Test prompt injection and cross-tenant leakage through retrieval, cache, and database paths.
Apply least privilege, audit logging, retention controls, and abuse-rate limits.

weeks.deliverable: A documented AI threat model plus passing authorization and isolation tests.

weeks.title: Performance and Cost Optimization
weeks.objective: Reduce latency and spend through measurement-driven caching, batching, and async work.
topics: Profile API, database, retrieval, and model latency separately
Add Redis response/semantic caching with invalidation and tenant-aware keys
Optimize prompts, context size, model choice, and output budgets
Batch embeddings and offload long jobs to workers with bounded concurrency
Load-test rate limits and report latency/cost quality tradeoffs

tasks.text: Measure API, SQL, retrieval, model, and worker latency independently.
Add tenant-aware Redis and semantic caching with invalidation tests.
Reduce prompt/context tokens and compare model selection against quality and latency.
Batch embedding jobs, load-test concurrency, and publish before/after cost and latency results.

weeks.deliverable: A before/after performance report with safe caching and token budget controls.

weeks.title: Production Infrastructure
weeks.objective: Package and deploy Python services with reproducible containers and CI/CD.
topics: Build multi-stage Docker images and local Docker Compose dependencies
Configure Linux services, Nginx reverse proxy, TLS, and health checks
Manage secrets and environment config without committing credentials
Create GitHub Actions for linting, type checks, pytest, and migrations
Deploy to a cloud target with PostgreSQL backups and rollback notes

tasks.text: Create production Docker images and Docker Compose for API, PostgreSQL, Redis, and worker.
Configure Linux deployment behind Nginx with health checks and secure headers.
Add GitHub Actions for lint, type checking, tests, migrations, and image build.
Deploy to a cloud environment and document secrets, backup, rollback, and PostgreSQL settings.

weeks.deliverable: A deployed Python AI API with CI, Docker Compose, Nginx, and documented operations.

weeks.title: Observability and Reliability
weeks.objective: Operate AI APIs and workers using structured telemetry and actionable health signals.
topics: Emit structured logs with request, tenant-safe, and trace correlation IDs
Instrument FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, workers, and model calls with OpenTelemetry
Track latency, error rate, queue depth, token use, and model/provider failures
Add readiness/liveness checks, alert thresholds, and background job visibility
Debug a simulated production incident and write an incident review

tasks.text: Add structured logs and OpenTelemetry traces to APIs, database calls, workers, and model providers.
Track latency, errors, queue depth, token usage, cost, and provider health.
Add readiness/liveness checks and a worker monitoring/runbook procedure.
Simulate a production incident and write an evidence-based incident review.

weeks.deliverable: A monitored service with traces, operational dashboard signals, and runbook.

weeks.title: Enterprise Python Architecture
weeks.objective: Design maintainable, scalable Python services with clear boundaries and failure behavior.
topics: Separate API, application, domain, and infrastructure responsibilities pragmatically
Design tenant-aware data models, constraints, ownership, and access boundaries
Plan API versioning, backward compatibility, and event/worker boundaries
Reason about reliability, queues, consistency, retries, and distributed failures
Record architectural decisions and tradeoffs with measurable constraints

tasks.text: Create component and data-flow diagrams for multi-tenant API, workers, database, cache, and providers.
Write ADRs for service boundaries, tenant ownership, API versions, and consistency.
Threat-model scaling, retries, queues, data deletion, and failure domains.
Review architecture with measurable requirements for latency, reliability, and data isolation.

weeks.deliverable: An architecture pack for a multi-tenant AI backend, including diagrams and ADRs.

weeks.title: Enterprise AI Assistant Platform
weeks.objective: Deliver a complete Python assistant platform with provider abstraction and controlled workflows.
topics: Define a provider interface for Ollama and hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoints
Integrate authentication, conversations, RAG, and LangGraph workflows
Provide SSE streaming and durable conversation/workflow state
Connect scoped business tools with RBAC, approvals, and audit logging
Add evaluation, security controls, OpenTelemetry, and integration tests

tasks.text: Implement provider abstractions for Ollama and hosted OpenAI-compatible services.
Connect authentication, conversation persistence, RAG retrieval, and LangGraph workflow.
Deliver SSE streaming with authorized business tools, approvals, and audit history.
Run integration, security, evaluation, and observability checks on one vertical slice.

weeks.deliverable: A working platform vertical slice with provider abstraction and documented limitations.

weeks.title: Portfolio and Deployment
weeks.objective: Make Python backend work reproducible, reviewable, and easy to evaluate remotely.
topics: Polish GitHub repositories, issues, commits, and pinned project summaries
Write project READMEs with setup, environment, API examples, and test commands
Publish architecture diagrams, OpenAPI references, and threat/evaluation notes
Create a live or locally reproducible Docker demo and short technical walkthrough
Write evidence-based case studies explaining decisions and measurable results

tasks.text: Polish at least three Python repositories with reproducible setup, tests, and meaningful commits.
Publish architecture diagrams, OpenAPI examples, threat model, and evaluation results.
Create Docker demos and concise technical walkthrough videos.
Write case studies that explain your engineering decisions, measurable results, and limitations.

weeks.deliverable: Three polished Python backend/AI repositories and a concise demo portfolio.

weeks.title: Remote Job Preparation
weeks.objective: Prepare credible evidence and interview fluency for remote Python and AI backend roles.
topics: Practice Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Redis, and security questions
Explain RAG, vector/hybrid search, agents, LangGraph, evaluation, and AI security
Complete timed practical Python/API/SQL exercises and system-design walkthroughs
Prepare technical English explanations and remote collaboration examples
Update CV, LinkedIn, role targeting, and a sustainable application pipeline

tasks.text: Practice Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Redis, and security questions aloud.
Complete timed Python, SQL, async API, and system design exercises with self-review.
Prepare concise technical English explanations for RAG, LangGraph, evaluation, and production AI.
Update CV/LinkedIn with evidence-based projects and build a target role/application tracker.

weeks.deliverable: A Python Backend/AI Backend application package and 30-day remote search plan.
